title: Disappearance of Los Alamos employee Melissa Casillas
place_text: Ranchos de Taos, New Mexico / Los Alamos National Laboratory

tellings.quote: Melissa Casillas is a 53-year-old administrative assistant at Los Alamos National Laboratory

plain: In 2025 a 53-year-old woman named Melissa Casillas, an administrative assistant at Los Alamos National Laboratory, the US government research laboratory in New Mexico, went missing near Ranchos de Taos, New Mexico. Michels tells this in an episode about American scientists going missing. He draws on what was said by Sierra Casillas and Mark Casillas, two people who share her surname, and on a GoFundMe, an online fundraising page, set up in her case.
